faehigkeiten.grund: Auslieferung wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt (megaphone vergibt je Abruf eine request_event_id, megaphone haengt ein timetoken an, Adresse traegt eine session_id, kein ETag und Cache-Control "max-age=0, no-cache, no-store", Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst megaphone.fm) - Byte-Offsets veralten (bei dynamischer Auslieferung sofort, gemessen 19.08.2026) und die Zeitachse verschiebt sich mit (eine Folge war 57 s kuerzer als 3,5 h zuvor), deshalb sind auch Sprungmarken in Sekunden unsicher

einzeiler: Celebrating a birthday in-studio with early book access, reality TV drama, and quiche.
kurzfassung: The hosts celebrate a birthday in the studio with early book copies, then dive into recent pop culture news. They discuss the messy divorce and leaked footage involving Jen Affleck and Zach, the unexpected new sweatshirt theme for the upcoming Met Gala, and the Songwriters Hall of Fame nominees. Later, they cover the arrest of Thomas Markle and wrap up the week with their traditional Queenie and Weenie awards.
stichpunkte: Celebrating a milestone birthday in the studio with early access to Sophia Franklin's memoir Daddy Issues.
Discussing Jen Affleck's divorce filing and the resurfaced, unflattering videos of Zach Affleck.
Reacting to the controversial new Met Gala theme centered around everyday clothing and sustainable materials.
Reviewing the 2027 Songwriters Hall of Fame nominees, including Lady Gaga and Shakira.
Covering the breaking news regarding Thomas Markle's arrest in Florida.
Concluding the episode with their weekly Queenie and Weenie of the Week awards over celebratory quiche.

clips.hook: Getting your hands on an exclusive manuscript early feels surreal.
clips.text: The hosts compare receiving early access to an anticipated memoir to iconic movie moments of getting confidential manuscripts.
